import { MeshStandardNodeMaterial, MeshBasicNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';
import { uv, vec3, mix } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, Mesh, PlaneGeometry, Color, AmbientLight, DirectionalLight } = ctx.THREE;

  const group = new Group();

  // 1. PALETTE & DESIGN TOKENS
  const colors = config.intent?.visualSpec?.colors ?? {
    ink: '#16161d',
    paper: '#e8ecf2',
    accent: '#ff2a38',
    surface: '#0b0b10'
  };

  const inkColor = new Color(colors.ink);
  const paperColor = new Color(colors.paper);
  const accentColor = new Color(colors.accent);
  const surfaceColor = new Color(colors.surface);

  // 2. STAGE BACKDROP (to prevent FLAT_VOID - gradient from ink to surface at z = -2.5)
  const backdropGeo = new PlaneGeometry(7.5, 6.5);
  const backdropMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ depthWrite: false });
  
  // TSL vertical gradient using colors
  const vUv = uv();
  const cBottom = vec3(inkColor.r, inkColor.g, inkColor.b);
  const cTop = vec3(surfaceColor.r, surfaceColor.g, surfaceColor.b);
  backdropMat.colorNode = mix(cBottom, cTop, vUv.y);
  
  const backdropMesh = new Mesh(backdropGeo, backdropMat);
  backdropMesh.position.set(0, 0, -2.5);
  group.add(backdropMesh);

  // 3. SECURE BACKING PLATE
  const backGeo = new PlaneGeometry(3.4, 2.2);
  const backMat = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial({
    color: surfaceColor,
    roughness: 0.85,
    metalness: 0.25,
    transparent: true,
    opacity: 0.98
  });
  const backMesh = new Mesh(backGeo, backMat);
  backMesh.position.set(0, 0, -0.05);
  group.add(backMesh);

  // 4. SIGNAL LINE (Precision Accent Red at the very bottom edge)
  const accentGeo = new PlaneGeometry(3.4, 0.025);
  const accentMat = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial({
    color: accentColor,
    emissive: accentColor,
    emissiveIntensity: 1.4,
    roughness: 0.2,
    metalness: 0.8
  });
  const accentMesh = new Mesh(accentGeo, accentMat);
  accentMesh.position.set(0, -1.1, -0.02);
  group.add(accentMesh);

  // 5. MAIN FEATURES CARD
  const cardGeo = new PlaneGeometry(3.2, 2.0);
  const cardMat = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial({
    color: paperColor,
    roughness: 0.6,
    metalness: 0.15,
    transparent: true,
    opacity: 1.0
  });

  const cardMesh = new Mesh(cardGeo, cardMat);
  cardMesh.position.set(0, 0, 0);
  group.add(cardMesh);

  // Load the card texture securely via the context textureLoader
  const imageUrl = config.imageUrl ?? (config.intent?.visualSpec?.imageUrl);
  if (imageUrl) {
    ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(imageUrl).then((tex) => {
      cardMat.map = tex;
      // Soften color to allow details to read and prevent BLOWN_WHITE_KEY
      cardMat.color.setHex(0xdddddd);
      cardMat.needsUpdate = true;
    }).catch((err) => {
      console.warn('Failed to load card texture, retaining fallback', err);
    });
  }

  // 6. DETAILED PRODUCT LIGHTING (Within local group bounds)
  const localAmbient = new AmbientLight(colors.ink, 0.45);
  group.add(localAmbient);

  const localKey = new DirectionalLight(colors.paper, 1.1);
  localKey.position.set(1.5, 2.5, 3.0);
  group.add(localKey);

  const localRim = new DirectionalLight(colors.accent, 0.75);
  localRim.position.set(-2.5, -1.5, 1.5);
  group.add(localRim);

  // 7. ENTRANCE STAGE ANIMATION (Weighted Settle)
  group.position.y += 0.35;
  group.scale.set(0.92, 0.92, 0.92);

  const entranceTimeline = gsap.timeline();
  entranceTimeline.to(group.position, {
    y: 0,
    duration: 0.95,
    ease: 'power3.out'
  });
  entranceTimeline.to(group.scale, {
    x: 1,
    y: 1,
    z: 1,
    duration: 1.1,
    ease: 'power4.out'
  }, '-=0.95');

  // 8. UNCOMPROMISING CLEANUP CONTRACT
  group.userData.cleanup = function() {
    if (entranceTimeline) {
      entranceTimeline.kill();
    }
    
    // Dispose geometry
    backdropGeo.dispose();
    backGeo.dispose();
    accentGeo.dispose();
    cardGeo.dispose();

    // Dispose materials
    backdropMat.dispose();
    backMat.dispose();
    accentMat.dispose();
    cardMat.dispose();
  };

  return group;
}
